exp.loadError: The expense claim could not be loaded.
exp.error.generic: The request could not be completed.
exp.error.network: The server could not be reached. Try again.
exp.denied.body: Ask your administrator for access to expense claims.
exp.gone.body: It may not exist, or it may not be yours to see.
exp.noEmployment.body: An expense claim is made for a current employment. Ask HR if you think this is wrong.
exp.list.description: Your expense claims, and those of the people you are allowed to see. Open a claim to read it, or start a new one.
exp.new.title: New expense claim
exp.new.description: Add a line for each expense, attach the receipts, then submit the claim for approval.
exp.claim.title: Expense claim {no}
exp.claim.description: The lines, their policy checks, the receipts and where the claim stands.
exp.via.payroll.help: The approved amount is added to your next pay.
exp.via.payment_batch.help: The approved amount is paid on its own, outside payroll.
exp.flag.blocks: This category does not allow it: correct the line before you submit.
exp.hidden.title: You may not see this amount
exp.hidden.note: Amounts are hidden from you on this claim.
exp.onBehalf: (you are making this claim for them)
exp.field.title: Title
exp.field.title.help: Optional: what the claim is for, for example a trip or a month.
exp.field.currency: The claim is paid in {currency}. A line in another currency is converted at the company's rate when you save.
exp.returned.title: This claim was returned to you
exp.returned.body: The approver asked for a correction. Change the lines, then submit it again.
exp.blocked.title: Some lines break a rule of their category
exp.blocked.body: {count, plural, one {# line cannot be submitted as it is.} other {# lines cannot be submitted as they are.}} Correct them or remove them, then submit again.
exp.submitFailed: The claim was saved but not submitted
exp.fix: Some lines are not complete. Fix the marked fields.
exp.line.remove.label: Remove this line
exp.line.currency.converted: Converted to {currency} at the company's rate when you save.
exp.line.receipt.required: This category asks for a receipt.
exp.err.date: Give the date of the expense.
exp.err.amount: Type an amount with digits and at most four decimals, for example 1250.50.
exp.err.amount.positive: The amount must be more than zero.
exp.err.currency: Give the currency as three capital letters, for example USD.
exp.err.quantity: Type a number more than zero.
exp.err.quantity.required: Give the number of days or kilometres for this category.
exp.submitted: The claim was sent for approval.
exp.submitted.flagged: The claim was sent for approval. {count, plural, one {# line carries a policy flag.} other {# lines carry policy flags.}}
exp.cancel.title: Cancel this draft?
exp.cancel.body: The draft ends and keeps its number. You cannot reopen it; make a new claim if you still need one.
exp.waiting: The claim is waiting for its approver.
exp.waiting.finance: The claim is waiting for approval, and finance decides after the manager.
exp.receipts.saveFirst: Save the draft first, then add receipts to it.
exp.receipts.help: Pictures (PNG, JPEG) or PDF files. Then choose the receipt on each line.
exp.receipts.failed: These files could not be added: {names}
exp.receipts.downloadError: The file could not be downloaded.
exp.receipts.listError: The receipts could not be listed.
exp.categories.error: The expense categories could not be loaded.
exp.categories.empty.body: HR has to add the categories of expense first. Ask HR.
exp.card.title: Expense claim
exp.card.flagged.body: Some lines are over the limit, use a receipt twice, miss a receipt or fall outside the claim period. Check them before you approve.
exp.decide.err.amount: Type an amount with digits and at most four decimals.
exp.decide.err.above: The approved amount cannot be more than was claimed.
exp.decide.err.reason: Give a reason when you approve less than was claimed.
exp.decide.note: Save the line decisions first. The Approve button of this task then approves the saved amounts; a line you do not change is approved as claimed.
exp.finance.title: Expense payments
exp.finance.description: Approved claims that wait for payment, and paid claims, with the payment status the payment returned.
exp.categories.description: The kinds of expense people can claim. The limits by grade and the per-diem and mileage rates are in the expense policy (HR policies).
exp.categories.help.code: The code the expense policy refers to.
exp.categories.help.kind: General: an amount. Per diem: a rate per day. Mileage: a rate per kilometre.
exp.categories.help.tax: A label for payroll (for example taxable or not); the rules come from the country pack.
exp.categories.help.component: The payroll component a claim of this category is paid through.
exp.categories.delete.body: {category} is removed from the choices. Claims that used it keep it.
exp.rates.description: The company's exchange rates for claims in another currency. A line is converted at the latest rate on or before the date of the expense.
exp.rates.help.from: The currency of the expense, three capital letters.
exp.rates.help.to: The currency the claim is paid in.
exp.rates.help.rate: How many units of the second currency one unit of the first is worth.
